name: Domopage
author: ssplugins

sections.description:
Domopage turns any listing on your agency website into a focused landing page for ads, email and social:

  • Paste a listing URL; title, description, price, key facts and photos are imported.
  • Review everything, choose the hero photo, edit the copy, publish.
  • Your logo, colours and font style on every page.
  • 6 languages (English, Spanish, German, Dutch, French, Italian) with a language switcher and hreflang tags.
  • Enquiry form with required privacy consent, spam protection and email delivery.
  • Optional AI copywriting and translation through the WordPress AI Client (WordPress 7.0+), or with your own Claude or OpenAI key.
  • Seller report: visitors, enquiries, WhatsApp contacts, countries, languages and traffic sources per page, printable for the property owner.
  • Cookieless, first-party statistics: no cookies, no IP addresses stored, no cookie banner needed for them.
  • Advertising compliance: EU energy label (A–G), agency registration number and legal notices, with warnings when your country requires information that is missing.
  • WhatsApp button that opens a chat pre-filled with the property and page link in the visitor’s language.
  • No external fonts, scripts or tracking added.

Domopage Pro and Agency

Domopage Pro is a separate plugin, available from https://domopage.com/pricing/. It adds 12 languages, more page designs including a new development layout, section controls, status labels such as New, Reduced and Sold, a hero video, feed import from Kyero, Resales Online and CSV, and weekly seller report emails. The Agency edition adds a leads table, reports across all pages, CRM webhooks, consent-based tracking codes and white label. Everything in this free plugin works fully without it.

External services

Domopage works on your own server. It only contacts outside services in the situations below, and only when you use the feature.

The listing website you import from

When you paste a listing URL and click Generate, your server downloads that page to read the title, description, price, facts and photo addresses. Nothing about you or your visitors is sent; it is an ordinary page request to the address you entered. Property photos are then shown from their original web addresses, so visitors’ browsers load them from that website.

WordPress AI Client (optional)

If you choose “WordPress AI” under Domopage → Settings → AI, the listing text (title, description, location, price and key facts) is sent to the AI provider you configured for your whole site in WordPress (Settings → Connectors), each time you ask Domopage to write or translate copy. The provider’s own terms and privacy policy apply. No visitor data is sent.

Anthropic Claude API (optional)

Only if you choose “Own key: Claude” and add your API key. When you ask Domopage to write or translate copy, the listing text (title, description, location, price and key facts) and your API key are sent to api.anthropic.com. No visitor data is sent.
Terms: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms — Privacy: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy

OpenAI API (optional)

Only if you choose “Own key: ChatGPT” and add your API key. When you ask Domopage to write or translate copy, the listing text (title, description, location, price and key facts) and your API key are sent to api.openai.com. No visitor data is sent.
Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use — Privacy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy

WhatsApp (optional)

If you add a WhatsApp number, landing pages show a link to wa.me. Nothing is sent to WhatsApp unless a visitor clicks the link; WhatsApp then opens with the property name and page address typed in.
Terms: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service — Privacy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy

Google Maps link

Pages with a location show a “View on map” link to google.com/maps. No map is embedded and nothing is sent to Google unless a visitor clicks the link.
Terms: https://policies.google.com/terms — Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Freemius (licensing and optional usage data)

On activation you are asked whether to share basic, non-sensitive data with Freemius (your WordPress and PHP versions, site URL and admin email) to receive security and feature updates. This is opt-in: click Skip and nothing is sent. If you buy or activate a licence, the licence check is handled by Freemius.
Terms: https://freemius.com/terms/ — Privacy: https://freemius.com/privacy/

Privacy

Page statistics are counted by your own site. A visitor is counted once per day using a hash of their IP address, browser and a random salt that changes daily and is then deleted, so visitors cannot be identified or tracked across days. No cookies are set and no IP address is stored. Country is read from your CDN (for example Cloudflare) if available.

No visitor or enquiry data is sent to any AI service. Enquiries are emailed to the address in Settings and are not stored by the plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin and activate it.
  2. Go to Domopage → Settings: add your logo, colours, languages, enquiry email and privacy policy URL.
  3. Go to Domopage → Create page, paste a listing URL and click Generate.
  4. Review, then Publish. Pages live at /property-lp/property-name/.

Send yourself a test enquiry before using a page in ads. If emails don’t arrive, install an SMTP plugin.
sections.changelog:
0.8.6

  • Photo import: galleries served from image servers without a file extension (such as Resales Online feeds) now import every photo instead of one.
  • Photo import: site logos and icons are never picked up as property photos, including from social sharing tags.

0.8.5

  • Each landing page can send its enquiries to its own email address (for example the listing agent). Empty uses the address in Settings.

0.8.4

  • Settings → Licence in Lite now explains how to install Domopage Pro and enter the licence key, instead of a button that opened the Create page screen.

0.8.3

  • Inline styles escaped on output; development files removed from the bundled SDK.

0.8.2

  • WordPress.org review: all 6 included languages available, styles and scripts loaded with wp_enqueue, nonces on the enquiry form and visit counter, support for the WordPress AI Client, external services documented.

0.8.1

  • Long property names: the heading shrinks automatically in three steps, the hero always keeps clear of the header, and the editor shows a word count with a tip past 8 words.

0.8.0

  • Pro: section controls. Show or hide sections, change their order and choose the hero height (full, 75%, 60%, 45%), as a site default in Settings → Brand and per page. Works with every design.

0.7.0

  • Pro: New development layout and design: project figures (completion, units available, developer, build progress), units and prices table with Available / Reserved / Sold, “From” price, floor plans, amenities and a brochure download, translated into 12 languages. “Ask about this unit” fills in the enquiry message.

0.6.2

  • Pro: Custom CSS box in Settings → Brand with a code editor, applied to every landing page.
  • Designs: clear notes when a page has its own design, and a one-click “make all pages use the site default”.

0.6.1

  • Reset statistics: per page on its seller report (all plans), and on Reports (Agency) for any date range or all time, one page or all, statistics and/or saved enquiries.

0.6.0

  • Agency: Reports page for any date range across all landing pages: visitors, views, form enquiries, WhatsApp contacts, daily chart, per-page table, sources, countries, languages and the list of people who enquired. CSV export and print to PDF.
  • Agency: custom “Listing source” for enquiries ({property}, {ref}, optional traffic source), shown in emails, Leads, CSV and webhooks.

0.5.3

  • Hero video starts as soon as the page opens, with no different photo shown first on larger screens.
  • New play-length slider (10–30 seconds) for how long the video plays before it loops.

0.5.2

  • Hero video always plays automatically, with no play or pause button.

0.5.1

  • Hero video: pause / play button for every visitor; visitors whose device asks for reduced motion get the photo with a Play video button instead of no video.

0.5.0

  • Font style “Your website’s font”: uses the heading and text fonts of your theme (Site Editor styles for block themes, style.css for classic themes), including the theme’s font files. Now the default for new sites.

0.4.9

  • Page screen: pick any languages and translate the page there; picked languages are switched on for the site.
  • Create page: spacing between switches.

0.4.8

  • Pro: hero video from an upload, an MP4 link, YouTube or Vimeo, with a page-speed guide, file-size check, photo-first loading and photo on phones by default.

0.4.7

  • Translate any time from the page screen: missing languages only, one language, or all again. Clear message when AI is not set up.
  • Photos: Select all / Deselect all, a live count, and unticked photos are kept so they can be ticked again later (also after feed updates).

0.4.6

  • Leads list queries rewritten so every value goes through prepared statements (Plugin Check).

0.4.5

  • Author shown as ssplugins.

0.4.4

  • New default colours: ocean blue and terracotta.

0.4.3

  • Feed import: optional maximum number of pages per feed.

0.4.2

  • Cleaner admin screens: consistent field sizes, spacing and section dividers on every settings, feed, leads and page screen.

0.4.1

  • Settings → Licence: see your plan, enter a licence key or manage billing in one place.

0.4.0

  • Pro: 12 visitor languages, 4 new page designs (Editorial, Split, Minimal, Noir), status labels (New, Reduced, Exclusive, Under offer, Reserved, Sold) with crossed-out previous price.
  • Pro: feed import from Kyero XML, Resales Online and CSV, synced every night; price drops are labelled Reduced and listings that leave the feed are marked Sold or unpublished.
  • Pro: weekly seller report email and a private report link for each seller.
  • Agency: leads table with CSV export, statuses, automatic deletion and WordPress privacy export/erase; signed webhooks for CRMs; GA4, Tag Manager and Meta Pixel loaded only after consent; white label.

0.3.0

  • Freemius SDK for Pro and Agency licences, upgrades and the optional usage opt-in.

0.2.0

  • Renamed to Domopage. Seller report, cookieless statistics, energy label and compliance settings, WhatsApp button, marketing consent option.

0.1.0

  • First release: URL import, Signature template, 6 interface languages (3 per page), email enquiries, optional Claude/OpenAI copy and translation.
